safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient is currently using the reliever (blue) inhaler twice daily can understate symptom frequency and asthma instability, potentially delaying escalation of therapy or urgent assessment. Accurate reliever use is a key marker of control and risk in an apparent exacerbation.
